name: Pokémon Black & White
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Striaton City Gym has three possible leaders: you fight Cilan if you chose Oshawott, Chili if you chose Snivy, and Cress if you chose Tepig — only one of the three order-10 entries is fought per run. The 8th gym is also version-dependent: Drayden leads it in Black and Iris in White, with identical teams (both listed at order 80). There is no classic Champion battle in the main story: after the Elite Four you fight N and then Ghetsis at N's Castle. N's lead dragon is version-dependent — Zekrom (Lv 52) in Black, Reshiram (Lv 52) in White; Zekrom is listed here. Champion Alder is postgame only and is excluded.
